mapper.select: SELECT v.VERSION_NO, v.SNAPSHOT_DATA, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MASTER_SOURCE_REL r WHERE r.MODEL_ID = p.MODEL_ID AND r.MASTER_RECORD_ID = p.RESULT_RECORD_ID AND r.STATUS = '1' AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0') AS SOURCE_MAPPING_COUNT FROM MERGE_PENDING_MASTER p LEFT JOIN MASTER_DATA_VERSION v ON v.ID = p.RESULT_VERSION_ID AND v.MODEL_ID = p.MODEL_ID AND v.MASTER_RECORD_ID = p.RESULT_RECORD_ID AND v.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND v.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE p.ID = #{pendingId} AND p.STATUS = '9' AND p.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND p.DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT m.SOURCE_RECORD_ID FROM MERGE_CANDIDATE_GROUP_MEMBER m JOIN MERGE_PENDING_MASTER p ON p.OBJECT_GROUP_ID = m.GROUP_ID WHERE m.MEMBER_ROLE = '1' AND m.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND m.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND p.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND p.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND p.OBJECT_GROUP_ID != #{groupId} AND m.SOURCE_RECORD_ID IN #{id} FOR UPDATE
